notes: Colour themes for colour-vision differences (the settings' Colours option): each replaces named colours of theme.json. The meaning-carrying colours are rune (the player's magic, focus, good news), grave (the dead: threats and their arrows) and fire (warnings, can't afford). Each theme keeps those three apart for its deficiency, checked by simulating it (Machado 2009, full severity) with a CIE76 difference of at least 30 (games/sepulcra-app tests: vision_themes_keep_meaning_apart). high_contrast brightens text and darkens panels for low vision.
